map.输入作用力与作用时间（或动量变化），按冲量 J=F·Δt=Δp 计算，用于碰撞与: Enter the force and the action time (or the change in momentum) and compute the impulse as J = F*Delta t = Delta p; used for the mechanical analysis of collisions and impacts.
map.力在时间上的累积等于动量变化。: The accumulation of force over time equals the change in momentum.
map.缓冲设计：录入减速所需动量变化，求延长作用时间可减小的平均冲击力（如安全气囊）。: Cushion design: enter the momentum change needed for deceleration and find how much the average impact force can be reduced by extending the action time (such as an airbag).
map.碰撞分析：由碰前碰后速度求动量变化，即所受冲量。: Collision analysis: find the change in momentum from the pre- and post-impact velocities, which is the impulse received.
map.教学演示：演示同样动量变化下，时间越长受力越小。: Teaching demo: show that for the same change in momentum, a longer time means a smaller force.
map.：示例：质量 1 kg 物体由 10 m/s 停在 0.1 s 内，Δp=10: : Example: a 1 kg object is stopped from 10 m/s within 0.1 s, so Delta p = 10 kg*m/s and the average force F = Delta p / Delta t = 100 N.
map.由质量与碰前速度求共同速度: Common velocity from masses and pre-impact velocities
map.由质量与半径求质点转动惯量: Moment of inertia of a point mass from mass and radius
map.冲量和功一样吗？: Are impulse and work the same?
map.不一样：冲量 J=Δp（力×时间）改变动量，功 W=ΔE（力×位移）改变能量。结: No: impulse J = Delta p (force x time) changes momentum, while work W = Delta E (force x displacement) changes energy. Results are computed in real time from standard mechanics formulas for physics learning, homework calculation and engineering estimation; for safety or actual engineering follow professional standards and measured data.

map.本工具取平均力；变力冲量为力对时间的积分，结果取等效平均。结果按标准力学公式实时: This tool takes the average force; the impulse of a varying force is the integral of force over time, and the result is the equivalent average.
